You are entering a fictional zone: reality has been suspended.
A man who fears death discovers the secret of immortality, but learns that eventually, everything dies - everything except him.
"The Immortal" by Carl Firth
Connect with the Filmmakers:
Director’s Statement:
The ideas behind The Immortal were driven by my own anxieties around ageing and death. Thinking through what would happen if you could live forever fascinated me as I followed it to its fullest extent. Death still scares me... but not dying would be far worse, and maybe there’s some kind of solace in that.
